customManagers.description: Keep the Ubuntu LTS tag and immutable digest synchronized between versions.env and the base Dockerfile
Append bounded Ubuntu base-image provenance inside the Renovate-owned Unreleased changelog block
customManagers.autoReplaceStringTemplate:
- Ubuntu LTS base {{{currentValue}}}@{{{currentDigest}}} → {{{newValue}}}@{{{newDigest}}}.
<!-- remote-dev-renovate-ubuntu: datasource=docker depName=ubuntu versioning=ubuntu UBUNTU_VERSION={{{newValue}}} UBUNTU_DIGEST={{{newDigest}}} -->

packageRules.description: Deny native Dockerfile ownership unless a later repository rule explicitly allows it
Allow only the pinned Dockerfile frontend through the native Dockerfile manager
Track Ubuntu LTS releases only and group all base-image references
Runtime pins, digests, locks and legal notices are updated atomically by check-upstream.yml
Repository policy requires human merge review for every Renovate dependency
